scope: Known conditional-mean reference on the fixed independent regression evaluation set. Not used for fitting or selecting models.
derivation: Independent mean-zero x3 contributes zero to the conditional mean when hidden. Its expected residual variance adds 0.02 * 1.5^2 = 0.045 to the 0.49 noise variance, because Var(x3) = E(x4^2) = 1.
